problem: Surplus-discovery workers are not consistently invoking the already-built canonical discovery dedup helper. During the live broad /wc wave, two workers independently proposed the same repository-host proposal-pin race canary but produced two different fingerprints/pins. This is runtime evidence of DESIGNED_NOT_USED, not a request to rebuild the dedup library.
acceptance: /wc discovery path invokes canonical discoveryFingerprint/buildProposalPin or one equivalent single owner before pinning
same semantic candidate from independent workers yields the same fingerprint and a single repository pin collision domain
existing duplicate pins remain preserved and linked as canary evidence rather than deleted

title: Wire canonical discovery dedup into /wc
mission: Integrate the existing discovery-dedup implementation into the actual /wc surplus-capacity path and add a canary/receipt that proves independent workers with semantically equivalent candidates converge on one canonical fingerprint before repository create-if-absent. Treat the two live duplicate pins as regression evidence; reuse rather than rebuild scripts/discovery-dedup-lib.mjs.

incident_repair.reason: A live ~50-worker canary produced semantic duplicate proposal pins despite a completed dedup implementation.

unblock_value.reason: Prepared-queue exhaustion is intentionally supposed to fan workers into deduplicated discovery; without enforced canonicalization, surplus capacity can multiply duplicate work instead of compounding it.

regression_prevention.reason: Verification control requires DESIGNED_NOT_USED mechanisms to create an integration/build opportunity or be falsified as unnecessary.

candidate_write_scope: scripts/discovery-dedup-lib.mjs or a single-owner wrapper if needed
falsification: The proposal is falsified if current /wc runtime evidence proves both live duplicate pins were generated from materially different canonical identities under scripts/discovery-dedup-lib.mjs, rather than from workers bypassing/misapplying the shared canonicalization path.
disposition_hint: AUGMENT_OR_FOLLOW_UP_COMPLETED_O-SWARM-DISCOVERY-DEDUP-BUILD-V1; do not rebuild the existing library from zero.
